# TS02-C1 — Stage-2 client orchestration — semi-fungibles

## What it is for

The client surface for semi-fungible collections — **64 entrypoints**: issuing, minting, roles,
transfers, sets, fragments, metadata, and the tokenised-company operations.

Talos is the only supported client path and the only gas-funded one.

## Where it sits

Above the collectables family.

## Traps

**Its operations take a type discriminator that is part of the key.** Semi- and non-fungible
collections are mirrored tables, and the same identifier can exist in both — so an operation
reaching the wrong one does not fail, it acts on a different token.

**One role operation does not take that discriminator**, because only semi-fungibles can carry it:
non-fungible quantity is fixed at one, so there is no add-quantity role to grant. It hardcodes the
semi-fungible path because there is no other.

**A preview's parameter list usually differs from its operation's.** Bind by name.
